params.name: include-closed-positions
params.description: If closed positions should be included in the query

params.name: include-marks
params.description: Include current quote mark (note: can decrease performance)

params.name: net-positions
params.description: Returns net positions grouped by instrument type and symbol

params.name: symbol
params.description:
A single symbol. Stock Ticker Symbol `AAPL`, \
                                 OCC Option Symbol `AAPL  191004P00275000`, \
                                 TW Future Symbol `/ESZ9`, or \
                                 TW Future Option Symbol `./ESZ9 EW4U9 190927P2975`

params.name: underlying-product-code
params.description: The underlying Future's Product code. i.e `ES`

params.name: underlying-symbol
params.description: An array of Underlying symbol(s) for positions (example: underlying-symbol[]={value1}&underlying-symbol[]={value2})

items.docs:
Returns a list of the account's positions.
            Can be filtered by symbol, underlying_symbol
